text:
Type: metal glass-door display cabinet
Use: showing and storing glassware, ceramics, books or collections; living room, dining room, home office
Style: industrial, retro, contemporary
Materials: powder-coated steel frame, clear tempered glass doors and sides, glass shelves
Colors: dark charcoal grey steel, clear glass
Shape: tall narrow vitrine with slim frames, glass on all sides, one hinged door with a small knob, two glass shelves, splayed legs joined by a cross stretcher, light and see-through
Feel: airy, nostalgic, curated, crisp
Goes with: dark wood, concrete, leather, green plants; industrial, retro or modern living and dining rooms

product.name: FABRIKR
product.description: With a glass-door cabinet you can show off as well as protect your glassware or your favourite collection.
